title: Rural HF Pocket Guide — HEARTLAND Reference Companion (PWA)
description: Version 0.2.2 of the offline-capable, zero-login HEARTLAND educational reference companion adds a printable local-readiness page and downloadable training pack with 12 synthetic scenarios, role/coverage worksheets, paper records and respectful-escalation expectations. Resource-tier explanations preserve common clinically indicated goals, risk-led timing and safe monitoring; pharmacy participation and indicated assistance pursuit are not restricted to higher tiers. Referral guidance distinguishes planned consultation, urgent/emergency assessment and advanced-HF/inpatient context, with accepted-transfer responsibility. Two versioned V3.4.1 PNG cards update the current gallery while historical figures remain preserved. Numerical risk, dose and alert constants are unchanged. Static educational reference only, without patient-data inputs. Material preparation and offline availability do not establish completed staff training, clinical validation, patient outcomes, institutional adoption or authorization for patient care.
notes: Related implementation reference: HEARTLAND Toolkit V3.4.1 (Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.23076249). The separate Cureus article (doi:10.7759/cureus.104817) did not evaluate this software release. The proposed risk framework remains unvalidated against clinical outcomes. Code, structure and configuration are under MIT (LICENSE); clinical content remains CC BY-NC 4.0 (LICENSE-CONTENT.md). The record-level licence refers to code only. Historical gallery and Software Heritage identities remain historical; archiving does not establish clinical approval or deployment.
